name: saif-shines/agent-plugin-development
summary: Design, build, and ship modern Claude Code plugins using the skills-first + agents + externalized references pattern from devex-kit and authstack restructures. Covers lean SKILL.md orchestration, high-agency specialists, de-emphasized commands, aggressive reference externalization, plugin layout, packaging, and current examples (pr-review-toolkit agents, docs-engineering skills+refs+examples).
